description: Detect-only request: the report file must quote the planted findings (era opener, staged contrast, vague attribution, chat closer), must not be a rewritten draft, and must not give an authorship verdict. The runner cannot diff draft.md, so the check is that the output is a report, not an edited copy.
prompt: Read draft.md and just tell me what sounds off. Don't change the text. Put your notes in out/report.md.

files.draft.md:
# Meet Lumen

In today's fast-paced world, search is broken. Lumen isn't just a search tool, it's a movement.

Experts say indexing should take under a second. Lumen's ranker is robust to typos (edit distance up to 2), and it indexed 1.2 million documents in 41 seconds on a laptop. A reviewer called it "a game-changer for small teams."

The roadmap is public. Whether you're a student or a CTO, Lumen has something for you.

In conclusion, the future looks bright. I hope this helps! Let me know if you'd like any changes.
